answer: Ask every key to lodge a sealed operator identity, encrypted to a threshold of seven randomly drawn auditors, before it can earn. Normally nothing is opened; the record just sits like a walnut in its shell. Only when a fraud flag is upheld do five auditors jointly decrypt the flagged keys, and if two seals name the same operator, both are slashed and every key under that name freezes. A farmer can hide in the lagoon for a while, but one caught key drags the whole fleet into the canyon, so running many keys becomes one shared bet.
